entries.en: ...I should look for a job magazine[n]and go underground in Shibuya.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Oh yeah, do you still have time?
It's not that I don't have time...
I have a lot of time.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hey! It's too early to be boring!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: We're here, anyway! Why don't we grab[n]some tea and we can continue the job[n]search?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You can't turn down an invitation from[n]Lady Ann. I'll stay with her for as long[n]as she wants!
